model.name: Blade antenna (867 MHz, mesh-sensitive)
model.description: Educational, mesh-sensitive PEC blade on a 300 x 300 mm ground plane. The default 50 ohm ideal line source is retained for reproducibility; its S11 has not passed mesh-convergence checks. feed_fraction selects an optional planar source width relative to the feed tab (0 = line, 1 = full tab). There is no measured antenna or specified connector. Use for geometry and numerical studies, not as a validated antenna design.
